problem_text:
A logistics company needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: weight 35 tons
* Shipment Beta: weight 41 tons
* Shipment Gamma: weight 30 tons
* Shipment Delta: weight 65 tons
* Shipment Epsilon: weight 67 tons
* Shipment Zeta: weight 64 tons
* Shipment Eta: weight 59 tons
* Shipment Theta: weight 65 tons
* Shipment Iota: weight 60 tons
* Shipment Kappa: weight 47 tons
* Shipment Lambda: weight 41 tons
* Shipment Mu: weight 30 tons
* Shipment Nu: weight 57 tons
* Shipment Xi: weight 52 tons
* Shipment Omicron: weight 49 tons
* Shipment Pi: weight 57 tons
* Shipment Rho: weight 33 tons
* Shipment Sigma: weight 32 tons
* Shipment Tau: weight 32 tons
* Shipment Upsilon: weight 45 tons
* Shipment Phi: weight 57 tons
* Shipment Chi: weight 35 tons
* Shipment Psi: weight 32 tons
* Shipment Omega: weight 54 tons
* Shipment A1: weight 60 tons
* Shipment B1: weight 68 tons
* Shipment C1: weight 43 tons
* Shipment D1: weight 37 tons
* Shipment E1: weight 47 tons
* Shipment F1: weight 31 tons
* Shipment G1: weight 41 tons
* Shipment H1: weight 60 tons
* Shipment I1: weight 68 tons
* Shipment J1: weight 33 tons
* Shipment K1: weight 34 tons
* Shipment L1: weight 31 tons
Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 tons. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total weight on a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
